1. Important Information and Who We Are

This policy ("Privacy Policy") describes how nostringscouture collects, uses, handles, processes, and stores the Personal Data (defined below) provided by any person who accesses or uses nostringscouture ("User" or "you"/"your").

Please read this Privacy Policy together with our Terms of Use, and any other privacy notice or fair processing notice we may issue or display on nostringscouture on specific occasions when we are collecting, handling, processing, or storing Personal Data, so that you are fully aware of how and why we use your information. This Privacy Policy supplements the other notices and is not intended to override them. Capitalized terms not defined here have the meaning given to them in the Terms of Use.

2. Aim of the Policy

We are committed to protecting the privacy of the User and ensuring that the Personal Data we collect is protected and preserved as required under applicable law. This Policy governs how nostringscouture collects, processes, handles, stores, and records Personal Data provided by the User while using the Services. This Privacy Policy is specifically aimed at:

  • Helping you understand the exact nature of the Personal Data that we collect and process;
  • Explaining why we collect and process Personal Data and what we do with it; and
  • Explaining your rights in relation to the Personal Data we use and how we use it.

By using or signing up for the Services provided by nostringscouture, the User agrees at all times to be bound by the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, it is your choice whether you wish to continue using our Services.

3. Types and Purpose of Personal Data We Collect

To provide our Services, and for the purposes described in Clause 4, nostringscouture collects, uses, stores, processes, and handles the following data of the User ("Personal Data"). The Personal Data collected may vary depending on the nature of the service availed by the User:

  • Your name;

  • Your postal address, shipping address, and billing address;
  • Your phone number;
  • Your Aadhar information;
  • Financial information such as PAN, GST number, and bank account details;

In addition to the Personal Data collected directly, you consent to nostringscouture collecting additional information about you from third-party sources such as business partners, affiliates, or publicly available sources, cookies, and IP addresses, for legitimate purposes including providing efficient and expedient Services.

Personal Data does not include information relating to an individual which is anonymous in nature or is not personally identifiable to a particular individual.

The privacy laws applicable to nostringscouture grant individuals certain rights over their personal data. These rights allow you to control the Personal Data that we collect and how we use it.

Your right Explanation

6. Data Security

nostringscouture uses generally accepted standards of technology and operational security — including pseudonymisation, encryption, access controls, and retention policies — to guard against loss, theft, tampering, misuse, alteration, unauthorised access, disclosure, proliferation, or destruction of Personal Data.

Despite these precautions, Users acknowledge that the internet cannot always be guaranteed to be entirely safe, and that data transmission over the internet carries inherent security risks. Use of nostringscouture is therefore at the User's own risk.

7. Third Party Disclosure

To the extent possible, nostringscouture will not intentionally disclose or transfer Personal Data to third parties (persons or entities that are not affiliates of nostringscouture) for their marketing purposes or otherwise, and will take reasonable steps to protect its confidentiality and security.   • To third parties as deemed appropriate by nostringscouture to perform or deliver its Services and contractual obligations;
  • To legal or professional advisors — including bankers, auditors, and insurers — bound by a legal, contractual, or professional duty of confidentiality;

The presence of a link does not imply endorsement of the third-party site or its content. nostringscouture disclaims all liability regarding third-party policies and websites; clicking such links may allow third parties to collect or share your Personal Data, and you access these sites at your own risk. 8. Storage of Personal Data

All information provided by the User is encrypted using Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology and stored on secure, firewall-protected servers. Thereafter, the Personal Data is transferred and stored on a secure blockchain to further safeguard its confidentiality and security.

9. Transfer of Personal Data

Your Personal Data may therefore be subject to privacy laws different from those of your own country. In such cases, nostringscouture will transfer your Personal Data in accordance with applicable privacy laws, and your acceptance of this Privacy Policy and use of our Services constitutes consent to such transfer.

10. Data Retention and Data Deletion

Data Retention: We retain your Personal Data only for as long as necessary under applicable law and to provide our Services. We may also retain it for legitimate business purposes, including fulfilling contractual obligations, making data-driven business decisions, or satisfying legal, accounting, or regulatory reporting requirements.

To determine an appropriate retention period, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the Personal Data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure, the purposes for which we process it, whether those purposes can be achieved by other means, and applicable legal requirements.

Data Deletion: Unless legally required to retain it, upon request we will delete your Personal Data or anonymize it so it is no longer identifiable to you as an individual.

Please note that anyone who sees content you provide may save it through screenshots, in-app functionality, or other capture methods, and digital information may in some cases be recoverable through forensic means or a device's temporary storage.

11. Time Limit to Respond

We aim to respond to all legitimate User requests within thirty (30) business days. Complex or multiple requests may take longer; in such cases, we will notify you within 30 days of receiving your request and keep you updated on its status.
